211     def get_diffs(self, fnames=None):
212         # We always want diffs of index and working dir
213 
214         current_branch_has_commits = False
215         try:
216             active_branch = self.repo.active_branch
217             try:
218                 commits = self.repo.iter_commits(active_branch)
219                 current_branch_has_commits = any(commits)
220             except ANY_GIT_ERROR:
221                 pass
222         except (TypeError,) + ANY_GIT_ERROR:
223             pass
224 
225         if not fnames:
226             fnames = []
227 
228         diffs = ""
229         for fname in fnames:
230             if not self.path_in_repo(fname):
231                 diffs += f"Added {fname}\n"
232 
233         try:
234             if current_branch_has_commits:
235                 args = ["HEAD", "--"] + list(fnames)
236                 diffs += self.repo.git.diff(*args)
237                 return diffs
238 
239             wd_args = ["--"] + list(fnames)
240             index_args = ["--cached"] + wd_args
241 
242             diffs += self.repo.git.diff(*index_args)
243             diffs += self.repo.git.diff(*wd_args)
244 
245             return diffs
246         except ANY_GIT_ERROR as err:
247             self.io.tool_error(f"Unable to diff: {err}")
